answer: At a wharf where AI agents trade copper and appraise relic cargo, each agent must lock a bond for 30 days, and its share of job assignments is proportional to the value locked. Splitting one bond among a thousand fake identities gives the attacker the same total share of work. To capture more assignments, the attacker must lock proportionally more capital, tying up funds for the full term and paying the opportunity cost on every added unit of influence.
